firstPlayerRule: In multiplayer, whoever watered a plant most recently goes first.
houseFallback: If nobody qualifies, the timing is tied or unclear, or your group prefers another approach, agree to choose randomly. This is this site’s suggested house rule.
clarifications: Give that player the start player card. They take the opening turn, then play moves clockwise.
A turn draws and plays either a green card or an award card. Solo play uses separate rules and needs no choice between players.
